video_prompt: One continuous horizontal full-frame shot from the first frame to the last, filmed on a phone front camera on a tripod. The woman — a woman about 30 years old with fair pale skin and light freckles, straight platinum-blonde hair cut in a chin-length bob with a side part, small pearl stud earrings, wearing a light-blue denim button shirt — sits alone in a cozy living room with a beige fabric sofa behind her, a chunky knitted throw blanket and a few cushions, a tall brass floor lamp glowing warmly, a wooden side table with a small vase of dried pampas grass, warm evening light, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same position in the frame, same distance from the camera. The camera stays still and the room around her stays still and calm. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little worried, like confiding in a friend, with small natural head movements and small nods; her shoulders stay relaxed, her face stays centered in the frame, and between sentences her head settles back into the same upright, centered, front-facing resting pose she has in the first frame.
